## Checklist

- [ ] Copied from `template/` and renamed cleanly (for new skills).
- [ ] `SKILL.md` `description` is specific and names trigger phrases.
- [ ] Registered in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (`source` relative to `./plugins`).
- [ ] No real data, names, emails, or secrets anywhere in the diff.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-manifests.mjs` passes locally.
- [ ] Installed and invoked once locally to confirm it loads.
- [ ] Added a short `README.md` in the plugin folder.
